newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Alusaf Hillside 96/97 output seen 497,895 T.
newsitem.headline: Alusaf Hillside 96/97 output seen 497,895 T.

text.p: South African aluminium producer Alusaf, a unit of Gencor Ltd, is set to produce 497,895 tonnes of aluminium at its Hillside smelter in the current financial year (July-June), the company said on Wednesday.
The forecast is up on initial targeted output of 490,567 tonnes of refined aluminium, a Alusaf spokesman said.
The Hillside smelter was commissioned in June last year with a design capacity of 466,000 tonnes, but actual production has been running well above this level.
Alusaf, near the port of Richards Bay, is one of the world's lowest cost producers of primary aluminium.
Its power and alumina prices are linked to London Metal Exchange (LME) aluminium prices.

Alusaf said in August when Hillside was running at a capacity of 490,000 tonnes that its total production from the new smelter and the older Bayside smelter was expected to be around 655,000 tonnes in the year to end-June 1997.
